title: Flor1d_ PVP Optimization 16x
description: A resource pack for both amateur and professional Minecraft PvP players. It's suitable for everyone, even for low-end PCs, as it features optimized 16x textures.
body:
A resource pack that will suit everyone from Minecraft PvP beginners to true professionals. It will even suit weak PCs, as it is optimized with 16x textures.

This resource pack includes:
-Replaced textures for armor, swords, apples, and totems of immortality
-Replaced hit and crit sounds
-Optimization
